title: Digital Innovation and Product Development Capability
problemSolved: King’s does not yet have a sustained multidisciplinary team or consistent product practices for moving emerging student-experience needs from discovery and prototype into secure, supported institutional operation.
whatChanges: King’s establishes a lean multidisciplinary digital product team to deliver King’s Edge and the focused first Student Experience Hub release while testing the capability model itself. During 2026/27, the team generates evidence about the product practices, specialist support, operating model and capacity the wider Hub actually needs. Any expansion in team shape or staffing is then driven by evidence from delivery and live use rather than assumed in advance.
